summary.text: Lela Alston, a Democrat, represents District 5 in the Arizona State Senate; her current term ends on January 11, 2027, and Ballotpedia says she did not appear on the ballot for the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she served in the Arizona State Senate from 1977 to 1995, then in the House of Representatives for eight years, and returned to the Senate after winning the District 24 seat in 2019.
The biography also says she joined the Phoenix Union High School District Governing Board in 2008 and taught in the district for 34 years; she lives in Phoenix.
